method_card.objective: Register a PI-supplied WeChat article or Xiaohongshu note as a community lead.
method_card.mechanism: Supply one JSON source with a public url plus optional user-exported text, title and captured_at; no parameters. Both link-only and exported-text modes require a recognized original host. No session or network search is performed.
method_card.estimator: community-lead.json reports the canonical link, acquisition mode, original digest, paragraph locators, and cited identifiers to look up independently.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public catalogue and original-source records; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source. Original materials retain their respective licences.
manifest.licence_basis: Europe PMC and Crossref public metadata and Open Access JATS terms; intake records retain original source rights.
manifest.limitations: Link-only input has no observed text. Community content can motivate follow-up and cannot substantiate an experiment independently.
